description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - The Customs Ordinance, Order Under Section 19A
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an order issued under Section 19(A) of the Customs Ordinance that grants customs duty exemptions. It contains statutory authority references, regulatory conditions for duty waivers, and legal requirements for compliance. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe by name, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities beyond his ministerial title, and the core content is regulatory in nature rather than focusing on government personnel or organizational structure.
